entities.name: NDOR1
observations: 594-aa query has 100% coverage and 65.0% identity to reviewed Danio rerio NADPH-dependent diflavin oxidoreductase 1 (Q6PFP6); 57.1% identity to human Q9UHB4.

Homology-supported function: FAD/FMΝ-dependent transfer of electrons from NADPH to protein-bound [2Fe-2S] clusters, supporting cytosolic Fe-S protein assembly; the homolog can also reduce CISD1 cluster.
Candidate reaction: 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-protein + NADPH → 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-protein + NADP+ + H+; annotated broadly as EC 1.18.1.-.
Pfam matches: Flavodoxin_1 (8–143), FAD_binding_1 (203–418), and NAD_binding_1 (452–555).

entities.name: NDOR1 Fe-S reduction
observations: Proposed overall electron-transfer stoichiometry: 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-protein + NADPH → 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-protein + NADP+ + H+ (Rhea RHEA:67716 mapping).
FAD and FMN are the annotated redox cofactors relaying electrons from NADPH to the [2Fe-2S] protein acceptor.
